description: Logseq is a privacy-first, open-source knowledge base and outliner that works on top of local Markdown and Org-mode files: daily journals, blocks with references and backlinks, tasks, queries and a graph view — an open alternative to Roam Research and Obsidian.
name: Logseq
seoDescription: Deploy Logseq with Docker Compose on Dokploy — the privacy-first open-source outliner and knowledge base that works on local Markdown files.
